# Distribution agreement

This agreement is between ⟦ORG|Larkfield Supply LLC⟧ (the “Distributor”) and ⟦ORG|Quillon Freight LLC⟧ (the “Sponsor”). The Distributor sells in the Territory (the “Territory”); the Sponsor’s Franchised Business (the “Franchised Business”) funds the Kew Project (the “Project”). The Project ends when the Distributor leaves the Territory.

The Sponsor appoints ⟦PERSON|Ivo Penrow⟧ to sign for ⟦ORG|Quillon Freight LLC⟧ (“⟦ORG|Quillon⟧”). ⟦ORG|Quillon⟧ runs the network (“Network”); each member may join the Network. The Distributor pays ⟦ORG|Quillon⟧ monthly.

Evidence is cited as Def.’s Statement of Uncontested Material Fact (“DSUMF”) ¶ 2; DSUMF ¶ 3 repeats it.
